59.articleExample: My time for these exercises and for reading was at night, after work or before it began in the morning, or on Sundays, when I contrived to be in the printing-house alone, evading as much as I could the common attendance on public worship which my father used to exact on me when I was under his care, and which indeed I still thought a duty, though I could not, as it seemed to me, afford time to practice it.

dictionaryExample.english: For two weeks they evaded the press.
dictionaryExample.chinese: 他们有两周一直避而不见记者。
dictionaryExample.source: Oxford Advanced Learner’s English-Chinese Dictionary (10th ed.; user-provided excerpt)

otherMeanings.english: evade (doing) something to find a way of not doing something, especially something that legally or morally you should do
otherMeanings.chinese: 逃避，规避（尤指法律或道德责任）
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: The defendant had tried to evade payment of taxes.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 被告曾试图逃税。

otherMeanings.english: to avoid dealing with or talking about something
otherMeanings.chinese: 回避，避开（处理或谈论某事）
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: Come on, don't you think you're evading the issue?
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 得了吧，你不认为你是在回避这个问题吗？

otherMeanings.english: evade doing something to evade answering a question
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: Her response was simply to evade the problem altogether.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 她的回答就是干脆回避了整个问题。

otherMeanings.english: evade somebody (formal) to not come or happen to somebody
otherMeanings.chinese: 使达不到；未发生在（某人）身上
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: The answer evaded him (= he could not think of it).
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 他答不上来。

60.english: the act of being present at an event or service
compare: attendance 指出席；attention 是注意力，形近义不同。
60.usage: 常接 at + 活动；本文与宗教礼拜有关。
60.articleExample: My time for these exercises and for reading was at night, after work or before it began in the morning, or on Sundays, when I contrived to be in the printing-house alone, evading as much as I could the common attendance on public worship which my father used to exact on me when I was under his care, and which indeed I still thought a duty, though I could not, as it seemed to me, afford time to practice it.

dictionaryExample.english: Attendance at these lectures is not compulsory.
dictionaryExample.chinese: 这些课不是硬性规定要听的。
dictionaryExample.source: Oxford Advanced Learner’s English-Chinese Dictionary (10th ed.; user-provided excerpt)

otherMeanings.english: [countable, uncountable] the number of people present at an organized event
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: There was an attendance of 42 at the meeting.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 有 42 人参加了会议。

otherMeanings.english: (formal) to be present at a special event
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: Several heads of state were in attendance at the funeral.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 有几位国家元首出席了葬礼。

otherMeanings.english: (formal) to be with or near somebody in order to help them if necessary
otherMeanings.chinese: 陪侍；随侍（某人）左右；服侍
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: He always has at least two bodyguards in attendance.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 他总有至少两名保镖护卫。

otherMeanings.english: (British English, formal) to be with somebody and do things to help and please them
(North American English) to check who is present and who is not present at a place and to mark this information on a list of names
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: Mrs Sakamoto had finished taking attendance.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 阪本夫人已经点完名了。

61.english: a religious service or the act of honoring God
compare: worship 指崇拜或宗教礼拜；service 是一次具体仪式。
61.usage: 本文是宗教活动名词，不是一般“尊敬”义。
61.articleExample: My time for these exercises and for reading was at night, after work or before it began in the morning, or on Sundays, when I contrived to be in the printing-house alone, evading as much as I could the common attendance on public worship which my father used to exact on me when I was under his care, and which indeed I still thought a duty, though I could not, as it seemed to me, afford time to practice it.

dictionaryExample.english: an act/a place of worship
dictionaryExample.chinese: 礼拜；礼拜场所
dictionaryExample.source: Oxford Advanced Learner’s English-Chinese Dictionary (10th ed.; user-provided excerpt)

otherMeanings.english: [uncountable] a strong feeling of love and respect for somebody/something
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: What she feels for him is akin to worship.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 她对他的感觉类似于崇拜。

otherMeanings.english: [transitive] worship somebody/something to show respect for God or a god, especially by saying prayers, singing, etc. with other people in a religious building
otherMeanings.chinese: 崇敬，崇拜（上帝或神）；（尤指在宗教场所）做礼拜
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: The Mayans built jungle pyramids to worship their gods.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 玛雅人在丛林里建起了金字塔来膜拜他们的神。

otherMeanings.english: [intransitive] to go to a service in a religious building
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: We worship at St Mary's.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 我们在圣马利教堂做礼拜。

otherMeanings.english: [transitive] worship somebody/something to love and admire somebody very much, especially so much that you cannot see their faults
otherMeanings.chinese: 热爱；爱慕，崇拜（尤指达到看不到缺点的地步）
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: She worships her children.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 她极度疼爱自己的儿女。

62.english: to demand that someone provide or do something
compare: exact 作动词是强行索取；demand 可仅提出要求。
62.usage: 结构 exact something from somebody；勿与形容词 exact“准确的”混淆。
62.articleExample: My time for these exercises and for reading was at night, after work or before it began in the morning, or on Sundays, when I contrived to be in the printing-house alone, evading as much as I could the common attendance on public worship which my father used to exact on me when I was under his care, and which indeed I still thought a duty, though I could not, as it seemed to me, afford time to practice it.

dictionaryExample.english: She was determined to exact a promise from him.
dictionaryExample.chinese: 她决意要他作出许诺。
dictionaryExample.source: Oxford Advanced Learner’s English-Chinese Dictionary (10th ed.; user-provided excerpt)

otherMeanings.english: correct in every detail
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: The new palace is an exact replica of the original building.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 新宫殿是原始建筑的精确复制品。

otherMeanings.english: (of people) very accurate and careful about details
otherMeanings.chinese: 严谨的；严格的；一丝不苟的
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: He was very exact about everything he did.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 他对所做的一切都很精确。

otherMeanings.english: (of a science) using accurate measurements and following set rules
otherMeanings.exampleEnglish: Assessing insurance risk can never be an exact science.
otherMeanings.exampleChinese: 估定承保的风险永远不会成为一门精确的科学。
